paracetamol.name: Paracetamol
paracetamol.uses: Used to reduce fever and relieve mild to moderate pain.
paracetamol.description: Used to reduce fever and relieve mild to moderate pain.
paracetamol.sideEffects: Usually well tolerated. High doses may damage the liver.
paracetamol.warnings: Avoid taking more than the recommended daily dose. Be careful with liver disease or alcohol use.
paracetamol.pregnancyWarning: Often used during pregnancy when advised, but pregnant or breastfeeding users should confirm with a clinician.
paracetamol.whenToSeeDoctor: Seek help for overdose, persistent fever, yellow eyes, severe weakness, or worsening pain.

ibuprofen.name: Ibuprofen
ibuprofen.uses: Used for pain, fever, inflammation, dental pain, and muscle aches.
ibuprofen.description: Used for pain, fever, inflammation, dental pain, and muscle aches.
ibuprofen.sideEffects: May cause stomach pain, heartburn, dizziness, kidney strain, or bleeding risk.
ibuprofen.warnings: Avoid with stomach ulcers, kidney disease, blood thinners, uncontrolled hypertension, or repeated use without advice.
ibuprofen.pregnancyWarning: Avoid especially late in pregnancy unless prescribed. Ask a doctor if breastfeeding.
ibuprofen.whenToSeeDoctor: Seek help for black stool, vomiting blood, chest pain, swelling, severe stomach pain, or breathing difficulty.

aspirin.name: Aspirin
aspirin.uses: Used for pain or, at low dose, to reduce clotting when prescribed.
aspirin.description: Used for pain or, at low dose, to reduce clotting when prescribed.
aspirin.sideEffects: May cause stomach irritation, bleeding, ringing in ears, or allergic reactions.
aspirin.warnings: Avoid combining with blood thinners unless a doctor directs it. Avoid in children unless prescribed.
aspirin.pregnancyWarning: Ask a doctor before use during pregnancy or breastfeeding.
aspirin.whenToSeeDoctor: Seek help for bleeding, black stool, severe stomach pain, wheezing, swelling, or allergic symptoms.

warfarin.name: Warfarin
warfarin.uses: Used to reduce blood clot risk when prescribed and monitored by a clinician.
warfarin.description: Used to reduce blood clot risk when prescribed and monitored by a clinician.
warfarin.sideEffects: Can cause bruising, bleeding, nosebleeds, or serious internal bleeding.
warfarin.warnings: Requires medical monitoring. Many medicines and foods can change its effect.
warfarin.pregnancyWarning: Can harm pregnancy. Users who are pregnant or planning pregnancy need urgent clinician guidance.
warfarin.whenToSeeDoctor: Seek urgent care for heavy bleeding, black stool, vomiting blood, severe headache, fall injury, or unusual bruising.

amoxicillin.name: Amoxicillin
amoxicillin.uses: Used for some bacterial infections when prescribed.
amoxicillin.description: Used for some bacterial infections when prescribed.
amoxicillin.sideEffects: May cause diarrhea, nausea, rash, or allergic reactions.
amoxicillin.warnings: Avoid if allergic to penicillin unless a clinician has reviewed it.
amoxicillin.pregnancyWarning: Ask a clinician before use during pregnancy.
amoxicillin.whenToSeeDoctor: Seek urgent help for swelling, breathing trouble, severe rash, or persistent diarrhea.

metformin.name: Metformin
metformin.uses: Used to help manage blood sugar in type 2 diabetes.
metformin.description: Used to help manage blood sugar in type 2 diabetes.
metformin.sideEffects: May cause nausea, diarrhea, stomach upset, or low appetite.
metformin.warnings: Kidney function may need monitoring. Follow prescriber instructions.
metformin.pregnancyWarning: Ask a clinician before use during pregnancy.
metformin.whenToSeeDoctor: Seek help for severe weakness, breathing difficulty, or dehydration.

amlodipine.name: Amlodipine
amlodipine.uses: Used to treat high blood pressure and some heart-related chest pain.
amlodipine.description: Used to treat high blood pressure and some heart-related chest pain.
amlodipine.sideEffects: May cause ankle swelling, flushing, dizziness, headache, or fatigue.
amlodipine.warnings: Do not stop suddenly without advice. Monitor dizziness or very low blood pressure symptoms.
amlodipine.pregnancyWarning: Ask a doctor before use in pregnancy or breastfeeding.
amlodipine.whenToSeeDoctor: Seek help for fainting, severe swelling, chest pain, or shortness of breath.

diclofenac.name: Diclofenac
diclofenac.uses: Used for pain and inflammation when suitable.
diclofenac.description: Used for pain and inflammation when suitable.
diclofenac.sideEffects: May cause stomach irritation, bleeding risk, kidney strain, or swelling.
diclofenac.warnings: Avoid with ulcers, kidney disease, blood thinners, or repeated use without advice.
diclofenac.pregnancyWarning: Avoid late in pregnancy unless prescribed.
diclofenac.whenToSeeDoctor: Seek help for chest pain, black stool, vomiting blood, or severe stomach pain.

omeprazole.name: Omeprazole
omeprazole.uses: Used for acid reflux, ulcers, and stomach protection.
omeprazole.description: Used for acid reflux, ulcers, and stomach protection.
omeprazole.sideEffects: May cause headache, stomach upset, nausea, or diarrhea.
omeprazole.warnings: Long-term use should be reviewed by a clinician when possible.
omeprazole.pregnancyWarning: Ask a clinician before use during pregnancy.
omeprazole.whenToSeeDoctor: Seek help for trouble swallowing, vomiting blood, black stool, or unexplained weight loss.

metronidazole.name: Metronidazole
metronidazole.uses: Used for certain bacterial and parasitic infections.
metronidazole.description: Used for certain bacterial and parasitic infections.
metronidazole.sideEffects: May cause metallic taste, nausea, headache, or dizziness.
metronidazole.warnings: Avoid alcohol during treatment and for a short period after unless a clinician advises otherwise.
metronidazole.pregnancyWarning: Ask a clinician before use during pregnancy.
metronidazole.whenToSeeDoctor: Seek help for severe rash, numbness, seizures, or persistent vomiting.

aspirin_warfarin.explanation: Aspirin may increase bleeding risk when taken with warfarin.
aspirin_warfarin.recommendedAction: Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this combination. Seek urgent care for unusual bleeding, black stool, vomiting blood, or severe weakness.
aspirin_warfarin.evidenceSource: Clinical review required before patient release

ibuprofen_warfarin.explanation: Ibuprofen can increase bleeding risk and may affect kidney function when used with warfarin.
ibuprofen_warfarin.recommendedAction: Avoid repeated use unless a clinician has reviewed it. Ask about safer pain-relief options.
ibuprofen_warfarin.evidenceSource: Clinical review required before patient release

aspirin_ibuprofen.explanation: Ibuprofen may increase stomach bleeding risk and can interfere with low-dose aspirin timing.
aspirin_ibuprofen.recommendedAction: Ask a pharmacist how to time these medicines and avoid repeated combined use without advice.
aspirin_ibuprofen.evidenceSource: Clinical review required before patient release

amlodipine_ibuprofen.explanation: Ibuprofen may reduce blood-pressure control and increase kidney monitoring needs in some patients taking amlodipine.
amlodipine_ibuprofen.recommendedAction: Use the lowest suitable dose for the shortest time and ask a pharmacist if repeated doses are needed.
amlodipine_ibuprofen.evidenceSource: Clinical review required before patient release

diclofenac_warfarin.explanation: Diclofenac may increase bleeding and stomach-ulcer risk when combined with warfarin.
diclofenac_warfarin.recommendedAction: Do not use this combination unless a prescriber specifically approves it.
diclofenac_warfarin.evidenceSource: Clinical review required before patient release

metronidazole_warfarin.explanation: Metronidazole can increase warfarin effect and raise bleeding risk.
metronidazole_warfarin.recommendedAction: Contact the prescriber or anticoagulation clinic for monitoring advice.
metronidazole_warfarin.evidenceSource: Clinical review required before patient release
